verdict.rationale: Deploying on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator is a fair question for a vector database, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes only Pinecone's managed serverless service, console, SDKs, MCP server and a local API mock, and never mentions a Helm chart, Kubernetes operator or self-hosted production deployment.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator
